at.description: The day it is read at, its end.

class_account_id.description: The class the options are over, by the resolution in force.

exercisable.description: Of those, the options vested: what exercises may take.

exercised.description: The options effective exercises turned into shares by the day, never back in the pool.

expired.description: The options their expiries let lapse by the day.

forfeited.description: The options the recorded grants' forfeitures took by the day.

granted.description: The options the recorded grants granted on or before the day.

outstanding.description: The recorded grants' options not exercised, forfeited or expired at the end of the day.

resolutions.description: Every resolution, drafts and recorded, the latest passed first.

returned.description: The options recorded forfeitures and expiries gave back on or before the day.

size.description: The shares set aside by the latest recorded resolution passed on or before the day; 0 while none is.

unallocated.description: What the pool leaves to grant: its size less what is granted, with what is given back.
